Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 14 September 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Burdeos, Panukulan, Polillo, Jomalig, Patnanungan, General Nakar, Infanta, Real).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Rizal(Rodriguez, Tanay, Antipolo, Baras, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Morong, Teresa), Laguna(Santa Maria, Famy, Pangil, Mabitac, Pakil, Siniloan, Paete, Luisiana, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Majayjay, Magdalena, Pagsanjan, Pila, Victoria, Santa Cruz, Liliw, Nagcarlan, Rizal), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray) and Quezon(Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Lopez, Calauag, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Gumaca, Macalelon, Pitogo, Unisan, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, Atimonan, Plaridel, Mauban, Lucban, Sampaloc, Tayabas, Pagbilao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Batangas, Cavite, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Lucena, Buenavista, Catanauan, General Luna, Mulanay, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso), Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Cabuyao, Calauan, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Los Banos, San Pablo, Binan, San Pedro), Rizal(San Mateo, Angono, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Taytay), Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria, Calumpit), Nueva Ecija(Gapan, Penaranda, General Tinio, Laur, Gabaldon, Bongabon, Palayan), Bataan(Mariveles, Limay, Orion, Pilar) and Pampanga(Santo Tomas, San Simon, San Luis, Candaba, Minalin, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Apalit) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
